description: This file contains unit tests for the behavior and scaling of stateless worker grains in an Orleans-based system. It tests activation counts, automatic scaling under load, and cleanup upon deactivation.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivationTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying stateless worker grain activation and scaling behavior in Orleans.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivationTests.Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class configuring the test cluster environment.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo-specific services, including shared state services for tests.

methods.name: SingleWorkerInvocationUnderLoad
methods.description: Verifies that a single activation is maintained under sequential requests.

methods.name: MultipleWorkerInvocationUnderLoad
methods.description: Tests Orleans' ability to automatically scale stateless workers under concurrent load up to a configured maximum.

methods.name: CatalogCleanupOnDeactivation
methods.description: Checks that deactivated stateless worker grains are properly cleaned up from the catalog.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Helper method to wait for a condition to become true within a timeout, used for eventual consistency checks.
